head: 2506c0e633e389010aca54f280785c63cdc65f48
scope: Fresh native macOS ARM64 exact-file integration suite on current working tree; no decode features and no other-platform runtime qualification.
verified_cases: Physical hardlinks are aliases while copied bytes remain independent physical files
Replacing a duplicate with a hardlink invalidates its prior observation
Same inode edits remain detectable even with restored modification time
Sibling root names sharing a prefix preserve both file sets
Non-UTF8 and whitespace path names preserve exact content partitions
Cancellation and limits remain explicit; healthy duplicate groups survive other member failures
limitations: Finite regression suite, not all filesystem interleavings
No destructive duplicate-removal API was added or tested
No production code change justified by this passing run
